$comment: Load and decks (ruleset v0; spec S2 section 8, settled 2026-11-07; numbers are proposals). A structure layer marks deck cells: units on an intact deck stand on it at deck height, not in the water below, unless the water surface tops the deck (awash). Segment strength = deck area (m2) x strengthKgPerM2 x its current strength permille / 1000; ice patches (patchCells square, on the map grid) hold iceKgPerM2PerMm per mm of the map's thickness. Load = the masses of units whose centre is on the segment, not swept ones; checked every field step (4 ticks); a segment fails when load >= strength at failChecks checks in a row. Strain stages creak, crack and sag at their thresholds (for the player only: regiments never read them, brief 2026-10-09), falling back stageHysteresisPermille below. A failed bridge segment's neighbours lose neighbourLossPermille of their maximum; a broken ice patch's lose iceNeighbourLossPermille; a broken patch is open water for the rest of the battle. iceSpeedPermille: speeds on intact ice (S2 3.2). coldDrowningTicks: drowning timers in a broken-ice hole (until S3 owns cold). Pontoons and trestles join with their specialists.
